sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_path" TEXT, "upi_id" TEXT, "default_currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "updated_at" TEXT, "deleted_at" TEXT, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "main_currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "cover_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'generated', "cover_path" TEXT, "simplify_debts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "default_split" TEXT, "invite_code" TEXT, "archived_at" TEXT, "direct_key" TEXT, "created_at" TEXT, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, "updated_by" TEXT, "client_updated_at" TEXT, "deleted_at" TEXT, "deleted_by" TEXT, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "claimed_at" TEXT, "tint" INTEGER, "created_at" TEXT, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, "updated_by" TEXT, "client_updated_at" TEXT, "deleted_at" TEXT, "deleted_by" TEXT, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced');
CREATE INDEX group_members_group ON group_members (group_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'expense', "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other.general', "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "total" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payers" TEXT NOT NULL, "shares" TEXT NOT NULL, "split_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'equal', "split_values" TEXT, "fx_rate" TEXT, "fx_rate_date" TEXT, "fx_source" TEXT, "fx_currency" TEXT, "fx_total" INTEGER, "fx_payers" TEXT, "fx_shares" TEXT, "receipt_path" TEXT, "recurring_id" TEXT, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'app', "created_at" TEXT, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, "updated_by" TEXT, "client_updated_at" TEXT, "deleted_at" TEXT, "deleted_by" TEXT, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced');
CREATE INDEX expenses_group_date ON expenses (group_id, date)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_member" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_member" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cash', "note" TEXT, "fx_rate" TEXT, "fx_rate_date" TEXT, "fx_source" TEXT, "fx_currency" TEXT, "fx_amount" INTEGER, "created_at" TEXT, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, "updated_by" TEXT, "client_updated_at" TEXT, "deleted_at" TEXT, "deleted_by" TEXT, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced');
CREATE INDEX payments_group ON payments (group_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "comments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, "updated_by" TEXT, "client_updated_at" TEXT, "deleted_at" TEXT, "deleted_by" TEXT, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced');
CREATE INDEX comments_target ON comments (target_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT, "actor_member_id" TEXT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_type" TEXT, "target_id" TEXT, "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" TEXT, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE INDEX activity_group_seq ON activity (group_id, seq)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_parts" ("expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "member_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "owed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fx_currency" TEXT, "fx_paid" INTEGER, "fx_owed" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(expense_id, member_id));
CREATE INDEX expense_parts_group ON expense_parts (group_id, currency)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "mutation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued');
CREATE INDEX outbox_record ON outbox (record_id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("scope" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_uploads" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "bucket" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_versions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_by" TEXT, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "client_updated_at" TEXT, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE INDEX record_versions_record ON record_versions (record_id, seq)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notifications" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "group_id" TEXT, "activity_id" TEXT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "read_at" TEXT, "created_at" TEXT, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "read_pending" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE INDEX notifications_seq ON notifications (seq)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "kinds" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "muted_group_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fx_rates" ("date" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(date, currency));
CREATE INDEX fx_rates_currency_date ON fx_rates (currency, date)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expense_id" TEXT, "interval" TEXT NOT NULL, "anchor_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_date" TEXT, "ends_on" TEXT, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, "template" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT, "created_by" TEXT, "updated_at" TEXT, "updated_by" TEXT, "client_updated_at" TEXT, "deleted_at" TEXT, "deleted_by" TEXT, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'synced');
CREATE INDEX recurring_templates_group ON recurring_templates (group_id)
CREATE INDEX recurring_templates_expense ON recurring_templates (expense_id)
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_search" USING fts5(expense_id UNINDEXED, group_id UNINDEXED, description, notes, member_names, amount_text);
